description: Get an attachment by GUID as text (default; PDF/OCR), binary (base64), recognition, or metadata. Optional saveToPath writes the result under allowed roots. To list a note's attachments, use evernote_get_note resources[].

as.description: View (default: text). text = PDF text layers and image OCR; binary = raw bytes as base64; recognition = Evernote OCR items plus extractedText; metadata = filename/mime/size/hash/hasRecognition without the body.

saveToPath.description: Optional local path to write the result (must be under allowed file roots; overwrites if the file exists). binary writes the file bytes; text writes extracted text; recognition/metadata write JSON.

name: evernote_get_resource
title: Get attachment
